title: 朝日杯FSの後に・燃ゆる炎

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I won't let anyone else take this race. I'm going to win it for myself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen won this race before… and now it's my turn to do the same!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What confidence in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I can defeat someone with bright eyes like her… If I manage to obtain enough courage to overcome her spirit…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I am getting goosebumps just thinking of it. My legs itch for the track—the blood in my veins cries for more!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Grampa, I promise you, I will best her and show you how much I have grown!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm back!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: By the way, I wanted to ask what race I'm aiming for next…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow, the first race of the Classic Triple Crown tour, and one that you can only compete in once in your life, just like the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This is one of those moments… "The gates wait for no one!" Hngh… I'm so excited, I feel like I could burst!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We start training right away the next day, with Sakura Chiyono O still bouncing off the walls with energy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… Was that everything we had planned for training today?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who's that running over there?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow, I can't believe she's still training. She must be gearing up for the Classics…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer? Can I run another lap?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to work just as hard as she is!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Sakura Chiyono O starts running again. She looks energized and exuberant as her feet kick off the ground with each stride.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Chiyo.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You hold so much potential in your hands. So much that you may even grasp the things I couldn't.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You know, Maruzen, you can run if you want to.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: C.B…

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You don't have to force yourself to hold back and simply watch from the sidelines. There's no need to make yourself grow up faster.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Isn't it a little too early to hand over the dreams you've been carrying to someone else, Hot Rod?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to give them just anyone. It's going to be her.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Everything I have, everything I am… it's all going to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two Umamusume glance down at the hardworking Sakura Chiyono O, who remains oblivious to their conversation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Instead, her sights are fixed upon her next goal—the Satsuki Sho.
